description: SOX / ITGC control agent demo (2026-10-19): an external-auditor workpaper look. 1920x1080 landscape; pale sage-green columnar-pad paper with faint green ruled columns and a red margin line; a right-edge binder index tab stack (WP-1..WP-9) as the progress indicator; DejaVu Serif headings with Liberation Mono figures; reference codes (WP-3.2) and tick-marks (ticked, tied, agreed, exception) drawn as red-pencil marks that stamp onto numbers; scenes change with a binder page flip; captions are margin annotations with a reference code; the end card is a preparer / reviewer sign-off block carrying the founder name. Voice Sadaltager.
